invariants.rationale: numOutputGroups is used for parallelism and bulk insert partitioning; most algorithms expect a positive number of output groups.
Clustering typically requires at least one record; an empty input may not trigger clustering actions.
There must be at least as many file groups as output groups for assignment; this ensures a feasible clustering layout.
A schema is necessary for writing records during clustering; null schema would cause failures.
Strategy parameters are used to customize clustering; presence of a map is assumed.
